summary: Short kerb at a zebra crossing; no cars parked on this main road stretch.
reasons: Pedestrian crossing markings on the kerb
No parked cars on this stretch
Tiny car park with accessible bay

drivers.seclusion: Park all round, no homes, but the spot is open and beside a path junction.
drivers.access_and_room: 13 m of kerb is mostly crossing markings. The adjacent car park has two or three small bays, one accessible, too short for a van.
drivers.traffic: Through riverside drive; cars pass at the kerb.
drivers.convention: Cars park further along the road, but none at this crossing.

flags: Low-lying: about 4.7 m, 98 m from Brisbane River
Park users walk past all day
sun_shade: Canopy trees on the river side shade the road from the north-east.
